subject: Designate arbitrary y value for base of geom_dotplot

messages.author: ad26d84a7dd6ccf1
messages.subject: Designate arbitrary y value for base of geom_dotplot
parts: I would like to be able to designate a value on the y axis to line up the dot bins in geom_dot. This would make for a nice overlay to show the density of data making up other geoms in the plot. In the picture below, I'd like to be able to move the dot base up to 0.4 on the y axis. Any suggestions welcome. Using geom_histogram is worse given it forces the y axis above 1. Does anybody have a trick?

messages.author: f99b567edf86f024
messages.subject: Re: Designate arbitrary y value for base of geom_dotplot
parts:
Using position_nudge should do what you want. e.g.:

> ggplot(data.frame(x=c(1,1,2,3,3,3)),aes(x=x))+geom_dotplot(position=position_nudge(y=+0.1))
